title: Unfinished Business
description: The widow living alone on Cooper's Row asked the temple herself why her husband still walks the street outside their old house at night - she has heard him, or thinks she has, three nights running. The Priest of Morthane does not correct her fear so much as answer it: the spirit has something unfinished, and it is likely something meant for her. He asks you to find it and see whether she can finally stop lying awake for footsteps.

objectives.description: Locate the restless spirit in Dalhurst at night
Learn the ghost's story and unfinished business
Give the widow the message so she can finally sleep
Witness the spirit's passage to the afterlife

notes: Threat: named - a widow on Cooper's Row (invented) who has gone three sleepless nights believing she is hearing her dead husband. Giver motive: she came to the temple herself; the priest is answering a specific grief, not enforcing doctrine for its own sake here. Consequence: not wired. Known duplicate of the temple file morthane_02_restless_spirit, deliberately differentiated - this copy is the widow's grief and a townsman's request; the temple copy is the priest's doctrinal insistence on the difference between a lingering soul and undeath.
